title: COVID-19 vaccination (2024–25 vaccine), age 18, not moderately or severely immunocompromised
grade: Routine vaccination (ACIP schedule; no USPSTF grade)
action: Administer at least 1 dose of 2024–25 COVID-19 vaccine to persons aged 18 years who are not moderately or severely immunocompromised.

denominator.quote: Age 18 years who are NOT moderately or severely

derived.window: The text names the 2024–25 vaccine formulation, which became available in late summer 2024. With the 2025 schedule year as MY, doses from Aug 1 of the prior year through Dec 31 of MY are treated as 2024–25 doses. This is an approximation and needs human review.
